_README: AMFI Code of Conduct, item 1: a distributor must disclose all commissions received,
and on digital platforms must prominently link to the rates receivable ACROSS COMPETING
SCHEMES — not just the ones it happens to sell. This file is that disclosure.
⚠️ THIS FILE MUST BE POPULATED BEFORE GO-LIVE. AssetPlus supplies the rate card once
registration completes (00_GO_LIVE_TRACKER.md §1 item A). Until `rates` is non-empty the
/disclosures page renders a visible 'not yet published' state rather than an empty table,
so an unpopulated file can never masquerade as a complete disclosure.
⚠️ KEEP IT CURRENT. Trail rates change. Update `asOf` whenever rates change and note the
change below. A stale commission disclosure is a conduct problem, not a content problem.
Coverage rule: list EVERY category AlphaPicker ranks, and within each category the full
range across all AMCs whose schemes appear in the rankings — not only those with clients.
category   — as it appears in the rankings (must match stats.json category labels)
trailMin   — lowest first-year trail % p.a. receivable across competing schemes
trailMax   — highest first-year trail % p.a. receivable across competing schemes
note       — anything material: B-30 incentives, clawback terms, differing 2nd-year trail
